bibl.title: Guidelines for editing papyri.
bibl.note: Text prepared at the request of the president of the AIP (August 2018) by a committee headed by Jean-Luc Fournet and made up of the following people: Rodney Ast, Amin Benaissa, Willy Clarysse, Hélène Cuvigny, Alain Delattre, Nick Gonis, Jürgen Hammerstaedt, Federico Morelli, Paul Schubert, Joanne Stolk, Katelijn Vandorpe. These guidelines were presented to the AIP General Assembly at the end of the XXXth International Congress of Papyrology (July 30, 2022). - 1. Editing Greek / Latin texts. - 2. Editing Demotic texts. - 3. Editing Coptic texts.
